Job description
Job Description:
St. Marina Health Partners is seeking an experienced Registered Nurse - ICU to join our overnight critical care team in Toledo, OH. The ICU RN delivers direct patient care, monitors ventilated patients, and coordinates with the intensivist team.
RequirementsActive RN license in the State of Ohio.BLS and ACLS certification required.Minimum 3 years of experience in an adult intensive care unit.Experience with Epic charting.Ability to work night shift, three 12-hour shifts per week including alternating weekends.
Preferred QualificationsCCRN certificationExperience in a Level II trauma centerTelemetry experience
